product.title: Process vs Results Lab — Football Edition
product.summary: A good decision can still lose; judge the reasoning, not only the scoreboard.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students make football calls where the right decision sometimes loses and the wrong one sometimes wins, then separate the quality of the choice from the outcome it happened to get.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

health.technicalBasis: Playtested end to end 2026-08-16. No defects found and no dominant strategy — always picking one quadrant scored 0 of 6. Reaches its first decision with no reading screen at all.

curation.tierBasis: Reaches its first decision with no reading screen at all, has no dominant quadrant, and makes one idea land cleanly. Deliberately narrow.
